description: Run one schema-store operation. Set `action` to one of save|load|list|delete. Consolidates the former schema.* tools with identical per-action behavior. Use action=save to persist a composed UiSchema beyond the 30-minute schemaRef TTL. Each save overwrites the named schema and increments its version counter, so only the latest version can be loaded; no ETags or conditional requests. apply is accepted and ignored: save and delete always write.

inputSchema.description: Grouped action-parameter tool for the schema family (save, load, list, delete). The `action` field selects the per-action handler; each branch reproduces the exact body of the corresponding per-action input schema plus the discriminator key. Uses plain JSON-Schema if/then (no AJV discriminator keyword).

action.description: Selects the schema-family operation to dispatch.

apply.description: Accepted for bridge dry-run/apply mode parity and ignored: this action behaves the same with or without apply (save and delete always write). Actions: save, load, list, delete.

name.description: Saved schema name in slug format (letters, numbers, hyphens, underscores). Actions: save (required), load (required), delete (required).

schemaRef.description: Reference to an in-memory schema produced by design.compose. Actions: save (required).

tags.description: Optional tags for filtering and discovery. Actions: save, list.

name: schema
